text:
sam: Quick alert from onboarding canary: quetzal-v2-int8 returned a tool_call where the 'tools' array was present but one entry had name set to a short nonprintable sequence. downstream parser treats it as missing name and errors. cc @infra.

maria: repro prompt: 'Please call the translate tool on "Hello world" to French' -> model response (raw captured):
```json
{"type":"tool_call","tools":[{"name":"\u0000\u0000","args":{"text":"Hello world","to":"fr"}}]}
```

sam: frequency ~1.8% in 300 sample canary run. looks correlated with small batch sizes and streaming checkpoints.

dave: I pulled token streams for failures: token ids around name often include repeated 0 and 2 (looks like padding/null) e.g. [210, 7, 0, 0, 2, 130]. Hypothesis: int8 quant path emits padding tokens into the generation due to a kernel pack mismatch at short sequence boundaries.

nina: mitigation options:
- runtime tolerant parse: treat tool entries with nonprintable name as invalid and drop them (and surface telemetry)
- soft-rescue: automatically re-prompt the model when tool name invalid: "Your previous response included an invalid tool name. Please re-output the tool_call with a printable tool name."
- router fallback: for responses flagged invalid, route to the fp16 variant and replay request
- schema: enforce name is non-empty and matches a whitelist regex in validator

sam: I pushed a router hotfix that does a 1-attempt soft-rescue and if that fails routes to quetzal-v2-fp16. Rolling to 15% for canary.

infra-bot: Hotfix deployed to 15% for quetzal-v2-int8. Metric rule added: toolcall.invalid_name.count > 5/5m -> auto-fallback to fp16 pool.

maria: local test after hotfix: 500 quick calls -> invalid_name dropped from 9 to 1. Reemits succeeded ~78% of the time.

dave: filed RW-ml/3498: tasks: add schema rule (printable name regex), add funcall onboarding vector to smoke suite (jittered punctuation, short batches), collect raw token streams for failing cases, run kernel bisect on int8 pack variants. Assigning infra+dave.

nina: long term: add structured-output fuzzing in model-onboard pipeline to surface these micro-batch/token-boundary failures early. Also consider emitting token-residue diagnostics to S3 for a limited window when schema violations occur (PII strip).

sam: thanks all. putting this into the weekly triage and pinging runtime for kernel investigation. :thumbsup:
